Animal Shelter Donation Impact Report
Fictional test document — all figures are illustrative
Organization: Happy Tails Animal Rescue
Reporting period: 1 April – 30 September 2027
Donation summary
Individual donations received: INR4,80,000
Institutional contributions received: INR2,20,000
Total contributions: INR7,00,000
Program activity
Animals provided with food support: 185
Animals receiving veterinary consultations: 96
Vaccinations administered: 140
Sterilization procedures supported: 38
Animals rescued and admitted: 52
Expenditure summary
Animal food: INR2,10,000
Veterinary care and medicines: INR1,65,000
Vaccination and sterilization: INR95,000
Rescue transport: INR40,000
Shelter hygiene supplies: INR30,000
Total listed expenditure: INR5,40,000
Interpretation
These counts describe reported activities in this fictional example. They do not establish long-term
animal health outcomes or prove that donations alone caused any observed change. Supporting
receipts and service records would be required for verification.
